content.title: 4 Private Villas, Rouiba
summary: Four individually delivered private villas in Rouiba, executed under a complete all-trades construction package including site roads, utility networks, and landscaping.
The scope covers structural works, facade articulation, and integrated site infrastructure to establish a cohesive residential enclave.
description: The development was executed as a comprehensive site package: reinforced concrete structural works, interior and exterior finishes, building services installations, and dedicated site roads and utility connections.
The architectural composition uses clean contemporary volumes, balancing private residential zones with integrated vehicle and pedestrian circulation across the four-villa site.
content.authority: A residential delivery where structural execution and site infrastructure are aligned from initial earthworks through to final handover.
